name: Candlelight: A Tribute to ABBA
description: Relive the magic of ABBA's greatest hits in an enchanting concert illuminated by thousands of candles.
longDescription:
Candlelight: A Tribute to ABBA is a musical concert presented by Fever, a global live-entertainment discovery platform. This event series aims to bring classical and contemporary music to unique venues, performed by local musicians, all under the soft glow of candlelight. This particular concert focuses on the discography of ABBA, the iconic Swedish pop group known for hits like "Dancing Queen" and "Mamma Mia."

Attendees will experience a concert lasting approximately 60-75 minutes, featuring instrumental renditions of ABBA's well-known songs. The atmosphere is designed to be intimate and reflective, suitable for an adult audience and those who appreciate a unique musical setting. The Hilton Porto Gaia provides a grand and comfortable indoor setting for the performance.

Tickets for this event are available for purchase online, with prices varying based on seating tier. The Hilton Porto Gaia is located in Vila Nova de Gaia, accessible from central Porto via a short taxi ride or by walking across the Dom Luís I Bridge. Specific public transport routes to the venue are available via local bus services.
